PURPOSE:
  Automation pipelines: lint -> typecheck -> test -> build -> deploy, plus dataset schema validation.

SHOULD CONTAIN:
  - ci.yml — PR gates
  - deploy.yml — production deploys (Vercel)
  - data-validation.yml — datasets/schemas validation on data changes

SEE: ADR-0001 (docs/decisions/ADR-0001-Repository-Structure.md)
